verdict: PARTIAL DRIFT: souji-verify.spec.md mostly describes the installed r2 tool, but its rg --basename recipe is not executable as written; SKILL.md is stale versus installed receipt behavior.

lane_report_agreement.verdict: DISAGREE with round-4 report's narrow claim that the SKILL.md receipt taxonomy was extended to reflect r4 findings.
lane_report_agreement.basis: Independent read of current SKILL.md:12-20 lists exactly pushed, moved-to-obsidian, stale; installed souji-verify.sh and souji-vault-verify.sh both implement metadata-prune, and the vault verifier also emits r4 reasons/vocabulary. The current taxonomy still omits metadata-prune. This disagreement is limited to the taxonomy-extension claim, not the round-4 tool result.

spot_checks.behavior: Legacy stale receipt for an old .out file
spot_checks.doc: SKILL.md:18 defines scratch types without *.out and uses the owning lane's last admitted round as the age condition.
spot_checks.result: DRIFT: installed behavior recognizes *.out and uses the explicit --stale-days threshold (default 1), not the lane-round date described by SKILL.md. Fixture lived under /tmp and was not removed.

additional_regressions.finding: SKILL.md pushed recipe directs git fetch, contrary to the installed verifier's no-fetch contract; taxonomy also omits metadata-prune.
additional_regressions.result: DRIFT: installed receipt resolution uses existing refs only and emits metadata-prune for absent worktree registrations with zero unique commits. The three-entry SKILL taxonomy is not exhaustive.
